takeaway: The first forecast built on the radar's own API measurements was tested on 478 apps and scored a rank correlation of 0.71, equal to its best; its top 15 held 5 real leaders, about ten times chance. A fake-repo campaign that had been feeding the radar's search terms was caught and removed.

findings.heading: First API-era forecast: 0.71 across 478 apps
findings.text: The Nov 1 ranking was compared on 478 apps, 4 to 10 times more than earlier forecasts. Rank correlation 0.71; 5 of its top 15 were real top-15 growers, where random picks would average about 0.5.

findings.heading: A fake-repo campaign removed
findings.text: 53 near-identically named 'rpocket-team' and 'resocket' repos (game cheats, Windows tweakers, clones) had entered through search terms mined from their own clusters; several already return 404. They are now out of scope and the search terms are reset.

findings.heading: Atlassian's Rovo MCP server: 2M+ monthly users
findings.text: Atlassian's shareholder letter reports over 2 million monthly active users of its Rovo MCP server. Read from search results.

findings.heading: Measured leaders cool
findings.text: Cloudflare's security-audit skill gained 1,607 stars (after 2,300), OpenMausBot 1,485 (after 1,999) and t3code 1,384; the DeepSeek Harness phone client dsh-Go leads at 14,918.

caveats: From Nov 1 the scorecard compares hundreds of apps, so precision@15 reads lower even when the ranking improves; compare it with chance (15 divided by the apps compared).
52 repos from a fake-repo campaign are now left out of the ranking; their observations are kept.
Company figures today come from search-result summaries.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
